title: check.queued v1
description: A model check attempt is queued as a job.

hook.description: The hook the check runs at.

rule_version_id.description: The frozen rule version the check runs against.

job_id.description: The job that runs this attempt.

blocking.description: True when the check makes its transition or action wait (a gate with on_fail block, or the approval policy).

claimant_seat_id.description: At task.before_claim, the seat holding the provisional claim; else null.

pending_transition_id.description: The pending transition the check gates, or null (at action.requested, or for a warn check).

action_id.description: At action.requested, the action checked; else null.

subject_kind.description: The kind of the check's subject: seat at task.before_claim and review.assign, question at question.asked, action at action.requested, review at review.failed, event at cost.reported; null at a hook with no subject (L408).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the hook's hashed inputs in lower-case hex (Gating.input_hash). With task, rule version, hook, round and subject it is the check's identity (L408, L771), so replay into empty tables can insert the rule_checks row.
